segments.oily: One reviewer with an oily face reports it helps serum absorption and reduces morning oiliness, and another with dry/oily combination skin reports more hydration and less oil after one use.
segments.sensitive: Reports diverge sharply: one reviewer without sensitive skin still had what she describes as a huge allergic reaction with tingling for hours, another explicitly non-sensitive user found the stinging severe ('BURN BURN BURN'), while a reviewer who identifies as sensitive/reactive says the product did not irritate her skin at all, and another recommends the weaker 2000 PPM version for sensitive skin.
segments.mature: A 48-year-old reviewer reports smoothing of textural issues, and another describes the product as a favorite for mature skin overall.
segments.combination: One reviewer describes her skin as dry/oily and reports increased hydration and reduced oiliness after a single use.

concerns.aging: A 48-year-old reviewer reports smoothed textural issues attributed to aging skin; no other age-specific outcomes are mentioned.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers report increased hydration and dewier, less oily skin after use, including one describing improved moisture absorption alongside retinal and acid use; no reports of increased dryness.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the product helps her skin recover more quickly from retinoids and acids and improves absorption of other actives without stinging; no barrier-damage complaints are reported.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the product faded sun spots on her nose; another reports it helped clear discoloration on her upper lip linked to enlarged pores.
concerns.blemishes: Two reviewers report a cystic pimple cleared or improved overnight after applying the product directly to it; no reviewer reports new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports less oily skin and better serum absorption; another describes reduced oiliness and dewier makeup wear after one use.
